deduplication.result: Repository code search and the complete open pull-request patch were checked for both station names, domains, official contact paths and dedicated music-submission mailboxes. No previous canonical music-submission-agent record or earlier use of either mailbox was found. Each station is stored once. General staff, bookings, advertising, programme and office contacts were excluded as submission substitutes, and each station's email and physical delivery methods were consolidated into one opportunity.

notes: Both opportunities are publicly authorized and free-first but remain needs_manual_review because detailed delivery requirements and international eligibility are not expressly confirmed. No email, form, file, link, physical package, login, CAPTCHA, payment or consent was submitted or bypassed.
